response.passage: Welcome to 'Chacha’s Chat Corner', located near the bustling Gandhi Market. Since 1998, Chacha has been serving spicy aloo-tikkis to hungry commuters. Our stall opens at 4:00 PM daily. Many customers ask why our tikkis are so crispy. The secret is the double-frying technique; because we fry them twice in hot mustard oil, the outer layer becomes exceptionally crunchy. Last Tuesday, a visitor named Mr. Sharma visited from Delhi and asked if we use frozen ingredients. We clarified that we only use fresh potatoes sourced from local farmers. Some people confuse our 'double-fry' method with 'deep-frying', but they are not the same. Our stall is managed by Chacha and his assistant, Ravi. While Ravi handles the payments, Chacha focuses on the frying process to ensure quality. We have served over 500 customers this week alone. Please note that we do not accept digital payments, as we prefer cash to keep the queue moving quickly. We look forward to seeing you at the stall soon!
response.summary: Chacha’s Chat Corner is a popular street food stall near Gandhi Market known for its crispy aloo-tikkis. The stall uses a double-frying technique with fresh potatoes and operates on a cash-only basis.
